fact.subject: Consumer.Group.Session.Timeout
fact.quotedToken: then the broker will remove this consumer from the group
fact.note: Doc comment lines 289-292: if no heartbeats are received by the broker before the session timeout expires, the broker removes the consumer and initiates a rebalance. The broker's group coordinator is not named on this line; the heartbeat goes to the consumer coordinator (line 298).

fact.subject: consumerGroupSession.heartbeatLoop
fact.note: The heartbeat loop is started in its own goroutine when the session is created (line 838); the doc comment at lines 29-30 says ConsumeClaim() runs in a separate goroutine, so the heartbeat is not driven by message processing.

fact.subject: Metadata.Retry.Backoff
fact.note: Used by heartbeatLoop (consumer_group.go line 1006) as the wait between failed coordinator lookups.

fact.subject: Metadata.Retry.Max
fact.note: Governs group liveness indirectly: heartbeatLoop in consumer_group.go uses config.Metadata.Retry.Max (line 1009) as its retry budget for coordinator lookup and heartbeat request errors before the loop exits.

fact.note: Logged by the client when a heartbeat returns ErrFencedInstancedId. The same text is logged at lines 335 and 402. The files do not state that the coordinator itself logs or exposes a removal, and no removal event is named for the session or rebalance timeouts.

fact.subject: Metadata.RefreshFrequency
fact.note: Set in NewConfig; 10 minutes. The comment at config.go line 149 says 0 disables it. Only the group leader runs the partition-count check, which cancels the session when the count changes (consumer_group.go lines 438-439, 699, 717).
